**Your hiring flow**
1. **See our post in Facebook groups** (no count yet)
   Leak: the post may not say pay, area, shifts or how to apply.
   Try: a pay-and-terms line with [blank]; one clear "WhatsApp us on [your business WhatsApp number]"
2. **Message us on WhatsApp** (40)
   Leak: the first reply may be slow, or it may skip pay, shifts and area.
   Try: a short greeting message with the key facts; saved quick replies for common questions
3. **Reply to our first message** (12)
   Leak: the first message may send the link without saying what the work is or what happens next.
   Try: say what sign-up involves and what happens after; a short FAQ (pay, hours, area, what to bring)
4. **Register on the app** (3)
   Leak: sign-up may be long, and nobody nudges people who start and stop.
   Try: fewer fields if you can; a "finish your registration" reminder
5. **Document check in person** (no count yet)
   Leak: people may not know what to bring, where, or when.
   Try: "Please bring the originals to show us in person on [date]"; a confirmation message the day before
6. **First home visit** (1)
   Leak: the gap between registering and the first visit may be unclear to the person.
   Try: tell them at sign-up what happens next and who will contact them, as a role; a welcome message before the first visit

**Fix first**
1. **Your first reply.** The biggest drop is between 40 messages and 12 replies. Setting out pay, shifts, area and one next step makes it easier to answer.
2. **The finish-your-registration reminder.** Only 3 of the 12 who replied registered.
3. **The pay-and-terms line in your Facebook post.** People who see the facts up front are better informed before they message.

I can't tell which of these is the real cause from the counts alone. A good check is to read a few of the 28 chats that went quiet after your first message and see where they stopped. Keep names and numbers out of any AI chat.

An automatic WhatsApp flow needs the WhatsApp Business Platform through an approved provider, people's opt-in and approved message templates. That's a builder project, not this helper. You can do most of the same job by hand with the free WhatsApp Business app (setup below).

**Your hiring flow**

   Leak: the post or page may not say pay, area, shifts or which roles you need.
   Try: a pay-and-terms line with [blank]; the roles and area in the first line

2. **They contact us** (25)
   Leak: the first reply may be slow, or may not say what happens next.
   Try: a greeting message that sets itself; quick replies for pay, shifts and area

3. **They start the app** (8)
   Leak: the link may come with no explanation, so people hesitate.
   Try: say how long sign-up takes; send one clear next step

4. **They finish registering** (2)
   Leak: the sign-up may be long or break part-way, and nobody nudges them.
   Try: a "finish your registration" reminder; fewer fields. Try the sign-up yourself on a phone and note where it stops. If it fails, that is for your app developer.

5. **Document check** (no count yet)
   Leak: people may not know what to bring or when.
   Try: "Please bring the originals to show us in person on [date]"

6. **First visit or shift** (no count yet)
   Leak: no welcome or clear first-day details.
   Try: a Day 0 welcome message (I can write the onboarding checklist next)

**Fix first**
1. **Your first reply.** The biggest drop is between 25 enquiries and 8 starting the app.
2. **The finish-your-registration reminder.** Only 2 of the 8 who started finished.
3. **The pay-and-terms line in your post.** It may help people decide before they message.

**Manual setup (WhatsApp Business app)**
- **Greeting message:** paste the draft above. It goes out automatically to new chats.
- **Away message:** for after-hours enquiries, with a line like "We reply by [time]."
- **Quick replies:** save shortcuts such as `pay`, `shifts`, `area`, `bring-docs` and `finish-reg`, so you can answer in one tap.
- **Labels:** make "New", "Replied", "Started app", "Finished", "Docs booked". Move each chat as it progresses. This also gives you counts by stage next month.
- **Reminder:** a person sends `finish-reg` to anyone who started but hasn't finished.
